IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id 
WHERE t.name = 'Facts' AND s.name = 'gold' )
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.Facts
WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'Facts',
        DATA_SOURCE = gold_source,
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
    )
AS
SELECT 
    o.DimOrders,
    c.DimCustomers,
    p.DimProducts,
    r.DimRegions,
    s.Quantity,
    s.UnitPrice,
    s.TotalAmount
FROM silver.silverTable s
LEFT JOIN gold.DimOrders o
ON s.OrderID = o.OrderID
LEFT JOIN gold.DimCustomers c 
ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN gold.DimProducts p 
ON s.ProductID = p.ProductID
LEFT JOIN gold.DimRegions r
ON s.RegionID = r.RegionID
AND s.RegionName = r.RegionName
AND s.Country = r.Country


SELECT * FROM gold.Facts
